import React from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import './CartDrawer.css'; function CartDrawer({ isOpen, onClose, cartItems, updateQuantity, removeFromCart, cartTotal }) { const navigate = useNavigate(); const handleCheckout = () => { onClose(); navigate('/checkout'); }; const handleContinueShopping = () => { onClose(); }; return ( <>

🛒 Your Cart ({cartItems.length})

{cartItems.length === 0 ? (
🛒

Your cart is empty

Add some delicious items from our menu!

) : ( cartItems.map((item, index) => (

{item.name}

₹{item.price}/{item.unit}

{item.is_regular === false && ( Advance Booking )}
{item.quantity}

₹{item.price * item.quantity}

)) )}
{cartItems.length > 0 && (
Subtotal ₹{cartTotal}
Delivery Calculated at checkout
Total ₹{cartTotal}
)}
); } export default CartDrawer;
